releaseNotes: fix: Apply Selected now removes same-text defined names at workbook AND sheet scope in ONE pass — every scope is its own repair target, so selecting all fixes fixes all in one click with one backup
fix: a fix transaction that fails partway now rolls back completely — the workbook returns to its exact pre-apply state instead of keeping half the fixes

fix: live audits no longer report an external workbook link as 'no formula uses' while direct external formulas exist — the capture cross-checks the formula inventory against a second, independent channel
improved: a successful apply shows one clear result line — fixes applied and verified, Broken Defined Names before → after, the backup path, and undo availability
improved: failed fixes list their exact reasons; Undo that cannot complete keeps its journal so it can be retried
